DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.search_keys: Performs Bing RSS web search using domain and terms to discover candidate URLs. The provider may return fewer URLs than max_results. Search web displays candidates only; all crawl actions search first. Provider/network failures are reported as failures.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.search_keys.domain: Domain to restrict search results to, for example 'wikipedia.org'.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.search_keys.terms: List of terms to search for. Only terms actually found on pages are included in crawler results.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.search_keys.max_results: Maximum number of search result URLs collected for each search term.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys: Controls Photon and Selenium crawling of the candidate URLs discovered by web search.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.photon_enabled: If true, Photon crawling is enabled.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.photon_depth: Maximum Photon crawl depth from each discovered search result URL.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.selenium_enabled: If true, Selenium processes Photon failures during Run all steps, or all search candidates when Photon is disabled.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.download_delay: Delay in seconds after Selenium loads a page before its rendered text is checked.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.output_keys.output_name: Base filename used when saving the crawler result JSON. The .json extension is added automatically.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.selenium_depth: Maximum Selenium link depth from each candidate; zero checks only candidates.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.crawl_keys.selenium_max_pages: Maximum pages attempted across all Selenium candidates in one crawl.
